answer: Reputation decays two percent per idle epoch and each identity earns at most one capped tranche per epoch, so a parked harbor of accounts cannot bank credit. A recruiter is barred from the panel reviewing its own recruit, removing the obvious collusion path. Numbers: 1,000 idle accounts lose about half their score in 34 epochs; 1,000 active ones earn 1,000 tranches, not more. This raises the quartz cost of maintenance. It does not prove personhood, and a patient willow of slow farms still slips through.
